newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells HRK33 mln 91-day T-bills, rate falls.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells HRK33 mln 91-day T-bills, rate falls.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it sold 33 million kuna in 91-day treasury bills at an auction instead of a planned 40 million.
The issued price rose to 97.095 percent from 97.036 five weeks ago, with the rate falling 25 basis points to 12 percent.
Almost 91 percent of the issue was sold to the banking sector and other investors bought only 9.39 percent, said a statement faxed to Reuters.
Bills are payable in two days and they mature on June 19.
The ministry set a new auction for April 1, when it will seek to raise 100 million kuna through 42-day T-bills.
It does not allow foreign entities to participate directly but they can place their bids through Croatian banks. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
